# SRD 5.2.1 System JSON

> Machine-readable JSON-LD 1.1 reference corpus for the System Reference Document 5.2.1 (D&D fifth edition rules, CC-BY-4.0), with JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 validation. 2,317 records: rules, tables, spells, feats, magic items, and monster stat blocks, each with verbatim source prose and line-level provenance.

Attribution: This work includes material from the System Reference Document 5.2.1 ("SRD 5.2.1") by Wizards of the Coast LLC, available at https://www.dndbeyond.com/srd, licensed CC-BY-4.0.

## Entry points

- [Full corpus context](https://cheeleong.dev/graph20/llms-full.txt): complete text of every record; answer rules questions from this single file
- [Aggregate manifest](https://cheeleong.dev/graph20/objects/srd52-system-data.jsonld): collection indexes and digests
- [Single-file bundle](https://cheeleong.dev/graph20/objects/srd52-system-data.bundle.jsonld): every record in one @graph
- [Search index](https://cheeleong.dev/graph20/objects/search-index.json): static inverted token index
- [JSON-LD context](https://cheeleong.dev/graph20/systems/context.jsonld)

## Collections

- [Spells](https://cheeleong.dev/graph20/objects/spells/): 338 records, e.g. objects/spells/fireball.jsonld
- [Monsters](https://cheeleong.dev/graph20/objects/monsters/): 332 stat blocks
- [Magic items](https://cheeleong.dev/graph20/objects/magic-items/): 258 records
- [Feats](https://cheeleong.dev/graph20/objects/feats/): 17 records
- [Rules](https://cheeleong.dev/graph20/objects/rules/): 1,113 records
- [Tables](https://cheeleong.dev/graph20/objects/tables/): 258 records
